protocol: All models scored with per-class thresholds tuned on validation patients, applied to test; seeds 42/7/123; single fixed patient-level split; MLP trained with the same optimization protocol as the GNN (AdamW, cosine schedule, boosted class weights, early stopping on validation macro-F1 with best-checkpoint selection).
notes: Seeds are not shared across models, so MLP and GAT are compared with GraphSAGE by Welch t-tests on per-seed macro-F1, and logistic regression (deterministic) by a one-sample t-test of the GraphSAGE seeds against its value. n = 3 seeds on one fixed patient split: p-values quantify training-seed variability only, not patient sampling. The seed-paired t-test used before v5 (p = 0.0017) was withdrawn.
table_note: Matched protocol on the fixed primary split: the MLP had the highest macro-F1 and every MLP seed exceeded every GraphSAGE seed. This single-split comparison is secondary; the leave-one-patient-out benchmark (results/revision) is the primary analysis.
